2609.04917.title: Artificial Intelligence in Equity and Crypto Markets: Progress, Profitability Evidence, and the Limits of Automated Investing
2609.04917.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) now supports investment workflows from data and prediction through research, portfolios, execution, and tool use. Technical capability, however, is not evidence of investment profitability. This critical state-of-the-art review examines public research available through 31 August 2026 on listed equities, exchange-traded funds, centralized crypto spot, perpetual futures, and on-chain markets. We organize evidence with an alpha-translation chain: point-in-time information must yield a stable signal, feasible positions, executable orders, and risk-adjusted returns after costs. Across machine learning, time-series foundation models, financial language models, reinforcement learning, and agents, the examined record shows real but mainly upstream progress in prediction, text processing, portfolio design, and workflow integration. Evidence is thinner for durable net performance. Temporal contamination, repeated selection, survivorship, weak benchmarks, implementation costs, venue mechanics, and capacity can break translation to net alpha. Strong historical results coexist with predictor decay, corrected look-ahead failures, mixed prospective evidence, and few audited live-capital records. Crypto adds informative state but requires separate treatment of spot, perpetual, and decentralized cash flows and execution. Within the public evidence examined here, no general AI architecture is shown to deliver persistent, cross-regime, capacity-aware net alpha. More credible claims require point-in-time data and models, decision-aligned objectives, joint portfolio--execution evaluation, controlled adaptation, prospective tests, and authority-matched governance. These conditions can improve evidence and implementation; they do not guarantee profit.
2609.04917.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）現在支持從數據和預測到研究、投資組合、執行和工具使用的投資工作流程。然後，技術能力並不代表投資的盈利性。這篇關鍵的前沿評論檢視了截至2026年8月31日可用的公共研究，涵蓋上市股票、交易所交易基金、集中式加密現貨、永續期貨和鏈上市場。我們用一個 alpha-翻譯鏈來組織證據：即時信息必須產生穩定的信號、可行的頭寸、可執行的訂單和經過成本調整的風險回報。在機器學習、時間序列基礎模型、金融語言模型、強化學習和代理的研究中，所檢視的記錄顯示出在預測、文本處理、投資組合設計和工作流程整合方面實際上有進展，但主要是上游的進展。對於持久的淨表現，證據則較為薄弱。時間污染、重複選擇、生存偏差、弱基準、實施成本、場地機制和容量都可能破壞翻譯到淨 alpha 的過程。強勁的歷史結果與預測器衰退、修正的前瞻性失誤、混合的前瞻性證據以及少量經過審核的實時資本記錄共存。加密貨幣增加了信息狀態，但需要對現貨、永續和去中心化現金流及執行進行單獨處理。在這裡檢視的公共證據中，沒有任何通用的 AI 架構顯示出能夠提供持續的、跨制度的、考慮容量的淨 alpha。更具可信度的主張需要即時數據和模型、與決策對齊的目標、聯合投資組合-執行評估、受控適應、前瞻性測試和權威匹配的治理。這些條件可以改善證據和實施，但並不保證盈利。
2609.04917.author: Linsen Zhu et.al.
